lastCompletedStory.title: Root-cause port-53 fail-safe: container teardown at session exit + init-firewall reap-and-retry

nextStoryContext: US-004 is the last story in this PRD's userStories[] array (priority 4, no requires); all four stories (US-001..US-004) now pass:true. This is likely the final implementer invocation for CAM-207 before the review cycle takes over. Two independent halves were built: (1) src/commands/stop.ts gained a new teardown leg (step 1f, right after the sidecar-liveness-watcher kill and before the state-file removal): gated on `readWorkerIsolation(join(cwd, 'scripts/cam/project.toml'))` (both `workerIsolationReader` and `containerName` are new injectable StopOptions, mirroring every other injectable-seam pattern already in this file), it calls `docker rm -f <DEFAULT_CONTAINER_NAME>` through the EXISTING `spawnFn` seam (no new spawn type needed) and records `report.containerTornDown` (new StopReport field), wrapped in try/catch so an absent `docker` binary or a non-zero exit (container already gone) never throws or blocks `cam stop`. Host mode (this repo's actual mode, and the fail-closed default when config is absent/malformed) makes this whole leg a no-op — verified in test/stop-container-teardown.test.ts's default-reader case (no injection, nonexistent cwd) confirms docker is never invoked. (2) .devcontainer/init-firewall.sh: the direct `dnsmasq ...` invocation was wrapped in a new `start_dnsmasq()` function; a companion `find_port_53_pids()` function parses `/proc/net/tcp` + `/proc/net/udp` (10th field = socket inode, port 53 = hex 0035) and cross-references `/proc/[0-9]*/fd/*` symlink targets (`socket:[<inode>]`) to recover the ACTUAL pid(s) holding port 53 — deliberately not relying on lsof/fuser/ss, none of which are installed in the slim worker image (see patterns.md bullet for why). On a bind failure, the script reaps every pid found this way (`kill -9`), sleeps 1s, retries `start_dnsmasq` once, and `exit 1`s (fail-closed) if the retry also fails. This part is NOT embedded/vendored and has no live-container gate in CI (per the existing devcontainer gotcha comment); AC3's oracle is explicitly `reviewer-judgment` (shell-logic inspection), not an executed test. file-size-budget.json: raised src/commands/stop.ts 640->687 only (the one file this story grew), with a dated _ref note prepended and staged before re-running check:all (the tracker-ref check reads the staged diff, not the working tree).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed docker rm -f force-removes a running container via SIGKILL then remove, matching the implementation's assumption (already noted in ensure-container.ts's existing comments) and the best-effort tolerate-non-zero-exit design for an absent container.
